author: The Critical Drinker
description: It was supposed to be a modern day classic. A $120 Million passion project 40 years in the making, with a star-studded cast, made by one of Hollywood's most influential directors. Instead, it turned out to be one of the most disastrous flops of all time, and a true case of Production Hell. Join me for the story of Francis Ford Coppola's Megalopolis.
title: Production Hell - Megalopolis
